MSI Vector A16

**Pros:** 1) Fast initial boot and setup.
2) Solid build.

**Cons:** 1) The power cord from the brick to the laptop is short. This limits movement of the laptop without the brick putting stress on the plug in the laptop
2) The number pad layout is smashed together and the key layout isn't normal. This will require most to "relearn" the layout if they use the number pad frequently.
3) The touchpad isn't centered to the keyboard. Not much of a problem if using a mouse but it is awkward to use.
4) Has Norton pre-installed. I just don't like Norton.

**Overall Review:** This is a good laptop.
The start up and shut down times are quick. Programs start and close smoothly with no issues. I've tried several games and apps and it functioned perfectly. From MC to DRG it ran them at the highest settings without issue.
The screen colors are bright and vibrant making every detail pop out.
Cooling fans do a great job keeping the temperature reasonable while also quickly cooking the system when intensive programs are exited.
The Cons are not big enough to affect my rating of this machine. Are there better machines? Yes, but over all a good machine at the cost.

- [Robert C.](https://www.newegg.com/d/profile/reviews/bk90MkpBRGxEOTh0aXdCSG9iNFUydz09 "View Robert C.'s Profile") posted on 2/8/2026
